findings.exit_volume: Stable overall, but concentrated in high-performers
findings.root_cause_1: Compensation lag vs market; average competitor offer increased by 12% in Q1.
findings.root_cause_2: Strict return-to-office (RTO) mandate enforced in Q1. This segment (Sales) values flexibility, and we are experiencing higher attrition to remote-first competitors, compounding the compensation issue.
